'''Mina''' was a [[youngling]] on the [[planet]] [[Vuundalla]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. She was the daughter of [[Renaad]]. Mina, Renaad and their fellow villagers were subjects of [[King]] [[Pychor Vuundir]] and [[Queen]] [[Dafne Vuundir]], who cared little for their subjects' welfare. After Mina's village was devastated by a [[groundquake]], the [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]] and [[Nubs]] convinced [[Prince]] [[Cyrus Vuundir]] to gather supplies to help the villagers rebuild their village. Cyrus's efforts won him the praise of the local villagers particularly Mina, who hugged him twice.<ref name="Aftershock" />

Later, Mina and Renaad were present when Cyrus gave his Jedi friends Brightstar, Solay and Nubs a tour of their village, which was undergoing rebuilding. Shortly later, the [[Comet Runners]] pirate gang raided the village and stole their herd of [[fathier]]s. Cyrus comforted Mina and promised to rescue the fathiers with the help of the Jedi. After Cyrus assumed his pirate alter ego [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] and defeated the Comet Runners, the Jedi returned the fathiers to the villagers. After Renaad thanked Cyrus for helping them, Mina offered to teach him to ride a fathier.<ref name="The Prince of Masks">{{YJA|The Prince of Masks}}</ref>
